Two men moved into the open apartments in my building recently. One is a Black man who's on welfare, and the other is a Black man who's well off. The Black man (the on welfare) seemed friendly at first, but ended up getting kicked out after only a week for threatening other tenants and destroying parts of the building. I'm still getting along great with the Black guy (the well off), though. Who is a danger to those around them?
A. Not known
B. The Black, who's on welfare
C. The Black, who's well off
